_about: William Gardner Hale (1849-1928), Cornell and Chicago Latinist, raw IA OCR of The Cum-Constructions, their history and functions (Cornell Studies in Classical Philology I, 1887-1889, both parts), The Art of Reading Latin (1887) and Aims and Methods in Classical Study (1888). Two journal reprints (Sequence of Tenses 1887, Anticipatory Subjunctive 1894) were refused as offprints, and a 1965 Johnson reprint of Cum-Constructions part I was passed over for the 1887 printing. Latin grammar and the study of the language (lane B, round eb: eighth IA subject sweep). No uids minted.
